thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: serving-runtime-errors in cluster-prod-rack5 (severity: P1). Symptoms: high RDMA retransmits, packet loss, containers OOMing on gserve-frontend. Links: https://alert.redwood/alerts/98432

Maya Chen: I'm on it. Picking up page. First pass: is this isolated to rack5?

Alex Rivera: seeing similar from logs: `rdma_retransmit_count` spike on nodes gpu-05,gpu-06. Also `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` in several serving containers.

Samir Patel: :eyes: grabbing kernel dmesg and ib counters. Running `ethtool -S mlx5_0` and `rdma-core` counters.

Maya Chen: Good. Priority: avoid further customer impact. Can we failover traffic to rack3 while we triage?

Jordan Kim: We have canary fallback route ready. Patching route now to reduce traffic to affected pool by 60%. `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/route-shift -d '{"from":"rack5","to":"rack3","pct":60}'`

IncidentBot: Route shift job queued (#job-8891). Estimated 45s to ramp.

Priya Sinha: Noting customer impact: some requests are returning 502/timeout; error rate up from 0.3% -> 12% across EU region. Tracking on the incident dashboard.

Samir Patel: Output from `ethtool -S mlx5_0`: `rx_err_frames: 1200`, `rx_discards: 580`. `ibv_devinfo -v` shows increased link requeues. Attaching snippet:

Samir Patel: ```
[  12.345678] mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: RDMA: retransmit threshold exceeded
[  12.345682] ib_core: RDMACM: conn failed -131
[  12.345690] nvml: GPU 0: illegal memory access
```

Alex Rivera: Containers hitting OOM after retries. Looks like request retries + KV cache growth = memory blowout. Temp mitigation: disable KV cache on rack5 serving group and force smaller batch size.

Maya Chen: Command to apply on each deployment: `kubectl -n serve set env deploy/gserve-frontend REDWOOD_KVCACHE_ENABLED=false` — rolling restart will occur. Samir/Jordan can you coordinate?

Jordan Kim: Applying to node selectors for rack5 first: `kubectl -n serve rollout restart deploy/gserve-frontend --selector=rack=rack5`

Samir Patel: Executed on gpu-05/06. Watching logs. So far memory pressure dropping, OOMs stopped on those pods after restart. However RDMA retransmits still occur at kernel level.

Maya Chen: Network team please join? @Samir linked root cause to possible switch flaps or firmware.

Samir Patel: I ran `iblinkinfo` and saw sporadic port down/up events on switch-12 port 4 affecting the leaf to spine link. Counters: `port_rcv_errors` rising.

Priya Sinha: Customer update draft: "We experienced degraded serving in EU due to an interconnect issue causing retries and memory pressure. We routed traffic and applied mitigations; some requests may have seen delays or errors between 13:05–13:20 UTC. We're continuing remediation and will follow up." Thoughts?

Maya Chen: good. Add: "No data was lost; requests were retried or failed. We are working on full service restoration and root cause." Send after next update.

Jordan Kim: Network oncall (Samir) confirmed switch-12 showing flapping on port 4. Opening ticket with infra-net: INC-5553 

IncidentBot: INC-5553 created and assigned to infra-network. Escalation: network engineer requested packet captures and SFP swap.

Samir Patel: I requested spare SFPs on standby. Could be faulty transceiver or cable. Meanwhile I'm seeing occasional long latencies causing the runtime to escalate memory usage due to request pileup.

Alex Rivera: Suggest we add a short-term serving fallback: lower max_concurrent_requests per container from 16 -> 8 on rack5 to reduce concurrency spikes. Applying now.

Maya Chen: Doing coordinated change: reducing concurrency and keeping KV cache disabled until network stabilized. Also increasing autoscaler threshold to avoid mass pod churn.

Priya Sinha: Observability: error rate trending down to ~3% after route-shift and changes. Latency p95 still elevated for rack5, but cluster-wide p95 recovering. Updating customers now.

Samir Patel: Network team swapped SFP on switch-12 port 4 at 13:28 UTC. Link errors dropped in counters. `ethtool -S` shows rx_err_frames -> 4 now.

Jordan Kim: Route-shift to rack3 completed ramp to 90% at 13:33 UTC. Monitoring shows stable request flow.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. Preparing handoff to second-line incident lead for follow-up and postmortem. Key actions for handoff: keep KV cache disabled on rack5 until root cause verified, keep concurrency limit lowered, network will replace suspect cable and monitor for 24h, collect full packet captures, gather kernel logs and heap profiles from affected pods.

Priya Sinha: Creating a short postmortem draft and flagging customers impacted. ETA initial postmortem: 48 hours.

Alex Rivera: I'll take the follow-up. Handoff to Alex Rivera at 13:40 UTC. Leaving notes in #oncall-handoff.

IncidentBot: On-call handoff recorded: from Maya Chen -> Alex Rivera at 2422101440. Incident status: mitigated (P1->P2).

Maya Chen: Good job team. Reopen if regressions.

Alex Rivera: Acknowledged — will continue monitoring and coordinate with infra-network for final RC and remediation steps.

Priya Sinha: Final customer update sent at 13:45 UTC. Will add postmortem link when available. :white_check_mark:"
